WITH major_counts AS (
    SELECT link_to_major, COUNT(*) AS member_count
    FROM member
    GROUP BY link_to_major
),
shares AS (
    SELECT member_count * 1.0 / SUM(member_count) OVER () AS share
    FROM major_counts
),
average_share AS (
    SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share
    FROM shares
)
SELECT
    SUM(member_count) AS total_members,
    AVG(share) AS average_share,
    AVG(share - avg_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM (
    SELECT major_counts.member_count,
           major_counts.member_count * 1.0 / SUM(major_counts.member_count) OVER () AS share,
           average_share.avg_share
    FROM major_counts
    CROSS JOIN average_share
) AS group_shares
WHERE share > avg_share;
